cards.title: Gelatinous Shot
cards.rules: A wobbling cube of jello shots. Something's floating in it. A tooth? Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It engulfs you. Drink 6, no hands.
It engulfs you. Drink 3, no hands.
You eat your way out. Give 3.
Natural 20! You eat the whole thing. Give 6.

cards.rules: Nine rats in a trench coat are trying to order a drink. Card them. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Their ID is better than yours. Drink 6.
Their ID is better than yours. Drink 3.
Bounced. Give 3 to whoever looks most like a rat in a coat.
Natural 20! Bounced. Give 6 to whoever looks most like a rat in a coat.

cards.title: Mold Elemental
cards.rules: The thing growing behind the ice machine has feelings and a mouth. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It moves into your lungs. Drink 5.
You breathe it in. Drink 3 and cough on your left neighbor.
Bleach. So much bleach. Give 3.
Natural 20! Bleach. So much bleach. Give 6.

cards.rules: A goblin who's had nine. He wants to fight you, then hug you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He wins both. Drink 6 and hug the person on your right.
He wins both. Drink 3 and hug the person on your right.
He passes out on you. Loot his pockets. Give 2.
Natural 20! He passes out on you. Loot his pockets. Give 4.

cards.rules: He's been restocking limes since 1974. Ask for a fresh one and roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He throws one at your eye. Drink 6.
He throws one at your eye. Drink 3.
He finds one. It's perfect. Give 3, with a lime if there is one.
Natural 20! He finds one. It's perfect. Give 6, with a lime if there is one.

cards.rules: The mop is moving on its own and it's coming for your shoes. Roll d6.

It mops your drink. Drink 3.
You trip it. Give 2.
You snap the handle. Give 3.
You wring it out over the sink. Give 3.

cards.rules: Eight legs, eight beers, zero manners. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Bitten. Drink 6, and do a spider walk to the fridge and back.
Bitten. Drink 3, and do a spider walk to the fridge and back.
Squished. Give 3.
Natural 20! Squished, and its web was full of coasters. Give 5.

cards.title: Tab Goblin
cards.rules: It's been putting drinks on your tab since 2019. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It collects. Drink 8.
It collects. Drink 4.

Natural 20! You stiff it. Give 6 to whoever owes you money.

cards.title: Goblin Shaman
cards.rules: A goblin in a bucket hat waves a burnt sage stick at you and chants. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The chant works. Drink 6.
The chant works. Drink 3.
You blow out the sage. Give 3.
Natural 20! You blow out the sage. Give 6.

outcomes.instruction: It gets tangled in your hair. Drink 3.
You shoo it into a bucket. Give 3.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You leave a shoe behind. Drink 4 and take one shoe off.
You leave a shoe behind. Drink 2 and take one shoe off.
You peel free. Give 2.
Natural 20! You peel free. Give 4.

cards.title: Tripwire

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You eat the stairs. Drink 4.
You eat the stairs. Drink 2.
You hop it. Give 2 to whoever strung them.
Natural 20! You hop it. Give 4 to whoever strung them.

cards.rules: The keg rack groans. Then it lets go. Roll d20 to dive.

Flattened. Drink 3.
You dive clear. Give 2.
Natural 20! You dive clear. Give 4.

A plastic shark to the skull. Drink 2.
You catch the shark. Keep it. Give 2.
Natural 20! You catch the shark. Keep it. Give 4.

Natural 20! You point them upstairs. Give 4.

Natural 20! You bribe him with a keg. He leaves his lucky pen. Give 8.

Natural 20! You tap the queen. The rack goes quiet. Give 8.

The court finds you guilty. Drink 4.

Natural 20! You dethrone him. Give 10.

Natural 20! You find a code violation. Give 10.

Natural 20! You spit in his bucket. Give 6.

Uncorked. Drink 3 and walk sideways to your seat.

Down on your ass, in red. Drink 2 standing up.

Natural 20! Not a drop on you. Give 4.

Migraine. Drink 2 and rub your temples.

Pop. Drink 2.

In your mouth. Drink 2 with a hand over your glass.

They have notes. Drink 2.

Natural 20! You've read it. They scatter. Give 4.

Stomped. Drink 4, then stomp your feet for 5 seconds.

He drains your glass. Drink 4.

Natural 20! He calls your boxed wine a Bordeaux. Give 10.

Rolled flat. Drink 4.

Natural 20! You surf a barrel out. Everyone else drinks 3.

Hexed. Drink 3, and confess your last search.

Natural 20! Garlic knots to the face. He drops something. Give 6.

It throws up sand on you. Drink 4.

Natural 20! You hand it a Gatorade. It weeps. Give 8.

cards.rules: Sold their soul for a better seat. −3 max hearts. +2 to every battle roll.

evolves.title: Hexblade
evolves.rules: −3 max hearts. +2 to every battle roll. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20.

evolves.title: Archfiend
evolves.rules: −2 max hearts. +3 to every battle roll. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20.

cards.title: The Plus-One
cards.rules: Nobody knows who invited them. −3 max hearts. −1 to boss rolls. Every 20 is rerolled.

evolves.title: The Plus-Two
evolves.rules: −4 max hearts. −1 to boss rolls. Every 20 is rerolled. −1 satchel slot.

cards.title: Flooded Stairs
cards.rules: The stairs are underwater. Every trap costs one more heart. Take a smoke bomb down.

boon.name: Flooded Stairs
boon.rules: Traps hurt 1 more. Starts with a Smoke Bomb.

cards.title: Happy Hour
cards.rules: Two for one, all the way down. Every heal heals one more heart. Everyone drinks 1.

cards.title: Running a Tab
cards.rules: You start two hearts short, but the bar put a shield and a draught on your tab.

boon.name: Running a Tab
boon.rules: −2 max hearts. Starts with a Coaster Shield and a Healing Draught.

cards.title: The Lock-In
cards.rules: Locked in until sunrise. Every boss takes one more hit to fall. Have a loaded die for it.

boon.name: The Lock-In
boon.rules: Bosses take 1 more hit. Starts with a Loaded Die.

cards.title: Cargo Shorts
cards.rules: Somebody wore cargo shorts. One more satchel slot tonight, and one pocket has a draught.

boon.name: Cargo Shorts
boon.rules: +1 satchel slot. Starts with a Healing Draught.

cards.title: Butterfingers
cards.rules: Everyone's already a bit gone. One satchel slot fewer, but you get two more hearts.

cards.title: Blood Moon
cards.rules: Blood on the moon. Every monster costs one more heart, but you start with two more.

boon.name: Blood Moon
boon.rules: +2 max hearts. Monsters, elites and ambushes hurt 1 more.

cards.title: Lefty Night
cards.rules: Drink with your off hand all crawl. Caught using the other: drink 1. That's all. Probably.

boon.name: Lefty Night
boon.rules: Drink with your off hand all crawl. Caught using the other: drink 1. That's all. Probably.

cards.title: Karaoke Night
cards.rules: Before every boss swing, the drawer sings one line of anything. Refuse: drink 2.

boon.name: Karaoke Night
boon.rules: Before every boss swing, the drawer sings one line of anything. Refuse: drink 2.

cards.title: The Regulars
cards.rules: The bartender likes you. You start with two more hearts.

cards.title: Thin Walls
cards.rules: Every trial costs one more heart tonight, but every heal heals one more.

boon.name: Thin Walls
boon.rules: Every heal heals 1 more. Trials hurt 1 more.

cards.title: Cold Open
cards.rules: Everyone drinks before the first door. Start a heart short, with a loaded die and shield.

boon.name: Cold Open
boon.rules: −1 max heart. Starts with a Loaded Die and a Coaster Shield.

cards.title: Brad Knows the Owner
cards.rules: The Quarter-Zips cut the line: Brad's cousin knows the owner. Name-drop harder. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! His cousin really does know the owner. Drink 6.
His cousin really does know the owner. Drink 3.
The owner has never heard of him. Give 3 to the best name-dropper here.
Natural 20! The owner has never heard of him. Give 6 to the best name-dropper here.

cards.title: Chad's Fake ID
cards.rules: Chad (left neighbor) and you: 10 seconds of Canadian accent each. Chad wins the vote: drink 3.

cards.title: We're Together
cards.rules: Thad cuts in, telling the bouncer 'we're together'. You're not. Roll 2d6 to argue.

outcomes.instruction: The bouncer believes him. Drink 3.
The bouncer believes you. Give 3.

dice.doubles: A pair! The bouncer sends them to the back. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Group Name
cards.rules: The Quarter-Zips have a group name, a hashtag and matching vests. Look cooler. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Nobody could look cooler. Drink 6.
Nobody could look cooler. Drink 3.
Your vest is a jacket. It's better. Give 3.
Natural 20! Your vest is a jacket. It's better. Give 6.

jinx.name: Champ
jinx.rule: Everyone calls the jinxed player 'Champ', like Brad does. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: The Guest List
cards.rules: Brad is on the list. You're on a napkin the bouncer is holding. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: The napkin blows away. Drink 3.
The bouncer blows his nose on the napkin. Drink 3.
The napkin holds up. Give 2.
You're on the list, and Brad's spelled wrong. Give 3.
You're on the list twice. Give 3.
Brad's off the list. Everyone else drinks 1.

cards.title: Gelatinous Shot
cards.rules: A wobbling cube of jello shots. Something's floating in it. A tooth? Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It engulfs you. Drink 6, no hands.
It engulfs you. Drink 3, no hands.
You eat your way out. Give 3.
Natural 20! You eat the whole thing. Give 6.

cards.title: Rats in a Coat
cards.rules: Nine rats in a trench coat are trying to order a drink. Card them. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Their ID is better than yours. Drink 6.
Their ID is better than yours. Drink 3.
Bounced. Give 3 to whoever looks most like a rat in a coat.
Natural 20! Bounced. Give 6 to whoever looks most like a rat in a coat.

cards.title: Mold Elemental
cards.rules: The thing growing behind the ice machine has feelings and a mouth. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It moves into your lungs. Drink 5.
You breathe it in. Drink 3 and cough on your left neighbor.
Bleach. So much bleach. Give 3.
Natural 20! Bleach. So much bleach. Give 6.

cards.title: Drunk Goblin
cards.rules: A goblin who's had nine. He wants to fight you, then hug you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He wins both. Drink 6 and hug the person on your right.
He wins both. Drink 3 and hug the person on your right.
He passes out on you. Loot his pockets. Give 2.
Natural 20! He passes out on you. Loot his pockets. Give 4.

cards.title: Skeleton Barback
cards.rules: He's been restocking limes since 1974. Ask for a fresh one and roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He throws one at your eye. Drink 6.
He throws one at your eye. Drink 3.
He finds one. It's perfect. Give 3, with a lime if there is one.
Natural 20! He finds one. It's perfect. Give 6, with a lime if there is one.

cards.title: Possessed Mop
cards.rules: The mop is moving on its own and it's coming for your shoes. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: It mops your face. Drink 3.
It mops your drink. Drink 3.
You trip it. Give 2.
You snap the handle. Give 3.
You wring it out over the sink. Give 3.
You ride it like a witch's broom. Everyone else drinks 1.

cards.title: Keg Spider
cards.rules: Eight legs, eight beers, zero manners. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Bitten. Drink 6, and do a spider walk to the fridge and back.
Bitten. Drink 3, and do a spider walk to the fridge and back.
Squished. Give 3.
Natural 20! Squished, and its web was full of coasters. Give 5.

cards.title: Tab Goblin
cards.rules: It's been putting drinks on your tab since 2019. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It collects. Drink 8.
It collects. Drink 4.
You stiff it. Give 3 to whoever owes you money.
Natural 20! You stiff it. Give 6 to whoever owes you money.

cards.title: Goblin Shaman
cards.rules: A goblin in a bucket hat waves a burnt sage stick at you and chants. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The chant works. Drink 6.
The chant works. Drink 3.
You blow out the sage. Give 3.
Natural 20! You blow out the sage. Give 6.

jinx.name: Goblin Tongue
jinx.rule: The jinxed player speaks of themself in the third person. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: Cask Bat
cards.rules: A bat lives in the empty cask and it hates the lights. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: It gets tangled in your hair. Drink 3.
You shoo it into a bucket. Give 3.

dice.doubles: A pair! You catch it barehanded. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: Clipboard Troll
cards.rules: You're not on the list. Walk heel to toe across the room and back. Wobble: drink 3.

cards.title: The Riddling Tap
cards.rules: A tap with a face. Your left neighbor asks a riddle: 10 seconds, or drink 3.

cards.title: The Stuck Door
cards.rules: Brace it shut with your back: wall-sit for 30 seconds. Stand early: drink 3.

cards.title: Keg Stand-Off
cards.rules: Stare down your right neighbor. First to blink or laugh drinks 3. You blink: drink 3.

cards.title: Sticky Floor
cards.rules: Your shoes are glued to forty years of spilled lager. Roll d20 to pull free.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You leave a shoe behind. Drink 4 and take one shoe off.
You leave a shoe behind. Drink 2 and take one shoe off.
You peel free. Give 2.
Natural 20! You peel free. Give 4.

cards.title: Tripwire
cards.rules: Someone strung Christmas lights across the stairs at shin height. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You eat the stairs. Drink 4.
You eat the stairs. Drink 2.
You hop it. Give 2 to whoever strung them.
Natural 20! You hop it. Give 4 to whoever strung them.

cards.title: Rolling Kegs
cards.rules: The keg rack groans. Then it lets go. Roll d20 to dive.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Flattened. Drink 6.
Flattened. Drink 3.
You dive clear. Give 2.
Natural 20! You dive clear. Give 4.

cards.title: Loose Tap Handles
cards.rules: A rack of novelty tap handles is right above your head. It's swaying. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! A plastic shark to the skull. Drink 4.
A plastic shark to the skull. Drink 2.
You catch the shark. Keep it. Give 2.
Natural 20! You catch the shark. Keep it. Give 4.

jinx.name: Thumb Master
jinx.rule: Whenever the jinxed player puts a thumb on the table, the last to copy drinks 1.

cards.title: Lost Bridesmaids
cards.rules: Two bridesmaids looking for the bathroom found you instead. They want a photo. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're in forty photos. Drink 4, and pose for one now.
You're in forty photos. Drink 2, and pose for one now.
You point them upstairs. Give 2.
Natural 20! You point them upstairs. Give 4.

cards.title: The Rat Pack
cards.rules: Three rats in fedoras, singing Sinatra, and they want your stool. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They do it their way. Drink 4.
They do it their way. Drink 2.
You heckle them offstage. Give 2.
Natural 20! You heckle them offstage. Give 4.

cards.title: The One-Armed Bandit
cards.rules: A slot machine older than the bar. Win, then cash out or pull again, harder. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Bust. Drink 6.
Bust. Drink 3.
Cherries. Give 2.
Natural 20! Cherries. Give 4.

cards.title: Mimic Cooler
cards.rules: A cooler in the corner is humming to itself. Open it, or walk away.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It bites. Drink 8.
It bites. Drink 4.
Cold ones, and something useful. Give 3.
Natural 20! Cold ones, and something useful. Give 6.

cards.title: The Fuse Box
cards.rules: A fuse box with one switch labelled DO NOT. Flip it, or leave it.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Every light goes out. Drink 6 in the dark.
Every light goes out. Drink 3 in the dark.
The jukebox comes on. Give 3, then pick a song.
Natural 20! The jukebox comes on. Give 6, then pick a song.

cards.title: Lost and Found
cards.rules: Everything anyone lost down here, plus a coaster that looks bulletproof. Drink 1.

cards.title: The Tip Jar
cards.rules: A tip jar lost under the shelves since 2011. A loaded die rattles in the coins. Drink 1.

cards.title: Wishing Drain
cards.rules: A floor drain full of coins and one fry. Toss something in. Everyone toasts the drain.

cards.title: The Dead Jukebox
cards.rules: It plays one song, badly, forever. Everyone sings the chorus, whatever they think it is.

cards.title: Rat Fence
cards.rules: A rat in a tiny vest is selling whatever fell behind the bar. He takes drinks, or blood.

cards.title: The Old Regular
cards.rules: He's been down here since the cellar was a bar. He'll trade a story for a story.

cards.title: Two Hatches
cards.rules: Two hatches in the floor. One is quiet. The other is playing Nickelback, loud, on purpose.

cards.title: Staff Only
cards.rules: Two doors: STAFF ONLY, and REALLY STAFF ONLY. Something growls behind the second.

elite.title: Grease Trap Horror
elite.rules: The grease trap has been fed fries for twenty years. Now it's hungry. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It slurps you in. Drink 8, then wash your hands in shame.
It slurps you in. Drink 4, then wash your hands in shame.
You seal the lid. Something shiny's stuck to it. Give 4.
Natural 20! You seal the lid. Something shiny's stuck to it. Give 8.

elite.title: The Health Inspector
elite.rules: Clipboard, hairnet, no soul. He's here to shut the cellar down. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Violation. Drink 8 and name three things wrong with this room.
Violation. Drink 4 and name three things wrong with this room.
You bribe him with a keg. He leaves his lucky pen. Give 4.
Natural 20! You bribe him with a keg. He leaves his lucky pen. Give 8.

elite.title: Keg Mimic Queen
elite.rules: Every keg in the rack opens one eye. The big one in the middle opens two. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The whole rack bites. Drink 8.
The whole rack bites. Drink 4.
You tap the queen. The rack goes quiet. Give 4.
Natural 20! You tap the queen. The rack goes quiet. Give 8.

spoils.name: Queen's Tap
spoils.rules: +1 max heart. Every heal heals 1 more.

spoils.name: Royal Jelly Shot
spoils.rules: +1 to monster rolls. Comes with a Healing Draught.

cards.title: Keg Golem
cards.rules: It's 800 pounds of lager and it's been tapped. Everyone drinks 1, then you roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It sits on you. Drink 8.
It sits on you. Drink 4.
You pull its plug. Give 5.
Natural 20! You drink it dry. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: Keg Plug
spoils.rules: +1 to boss rolls. Comes with a Coaster Shield.

cards.title: The Rat King
cards.rules: Forty rats in one crown, holding court in the grease trap. Bow, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The court finds you delicious. Finish your drink.
The court finds you guilty. Drink 4.
You dethrone him. Give 5.
Natural 20! You dethrone him. Give 10.

jinx.name: Royal Decree
jinx.rule: Everyone calls the jinxed player Your Majesty. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: The Landlord
cards.rules: He wants three months' rent and he's taking it out of your drink. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Evicted. Finish your drink.
Late fee. Drink 4.
You find a code violation. Give 5.
Natural 20! You find a code violation. Give 10.

cards.title: Big Cheese
cards.rules: A rat the size of a fridge, wearing a cheese wheel as armor. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It sits on your snacks. Drink 8.
It sits on your snacks. Drink 4.
You eat through the armor. Give 5.
Natural 20! You eat the armor and the rat. Everyone else drinks 3.

cards.title: The Pipe Organ
cards.rules: Every pipe in the cellar is playing one chord, and it's coming from a face. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You join the chord. Hum for 10 seconds, then drink 6.
The chord hits you in the teeth. Drink 4.
You find the off switch. Give 5.
Natural 20! You find the off switch. Give 10.

spoils.name: Pipe Whistle
spoils.rules: +2 to ambush rolls. Comes with a Smoke Bomb.

cards.title: The Stairwell
cards.rules: A cold stairwell and one flickering bulb. Everyone stretches. Level up, or sit down.

cards.title: The Smoking Area
cards.rules: Fresh air, a broken heater and somebody's vape. Everyone tells the table one thing so far.

cards.title: The Coat Check
cards.rules: Nobody's working the coat check. Everyone tries on one coat. Level up, or nap on the pile.

cards.title: The Bathroom Line
cards.rules: The line is twelve people long and everyone is your best friend. Hype up the person beside you.

cards.title: Bottle Service
cards.rules: A server brings a sparkler bottle and a bill for $900. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: You sign it. Drink 3.
It was for the next table. Give 3.

dice.doubles: A pair! It's on the house. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Influencer
cards.rules: Take the most flattering photo of the table in 10 seconds. The table hates it: drink 3.

cards.title: The Bodyguard
cards.rules: Six-five, an earpiece, no neck. He wants to see your wristband. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! No wristband. Drink 6.
No wristband. Drink 3.
You walk in like you own it. Give 3.
Natural 20! You walk in like you own it. Give 6.

cards.title: The Promoter
cards.rules: He's put your name on a list. You don't know which list. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're the promoter now. Finish your drink.
The bad list. Drink 4.
You're on his list now. Give 4.
Natural 20! You're on his list now. Give 8.

jinx.name: Talk to My Agent
jinx.rule: Nobody speaks to the jinxed player except through someone else. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: Bachelor Ghosts
cards.rules: The ghosts of a 1998 bachelor party want one more round. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're in the round. Drink 8 and tell your worst wedding story.
You're in the round. Drink 4 and tell your worst wedding story.
You exorcise them with karaoke. Give 4.
Natural 20! You exorcise them with karaoke. Give 8.

cards.title: The Ex Wraith
cards.rules: A wraith with your ex's face reads your old texts aloud, with feeling. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It reads the drafts. Finish your drink.
Every word lands. Drink 4.
You read theirs back. Give 4 to whoever has the worst ex.
Natural 20! You read theirs back. Give 8 to whoever has the worst ex.

cards.title: Bone Sommelier
cards.rules: A skeleton swirls a glass, sniffs yours, and calls it cute. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Shamed. Drink 8.
Shamed. Drink 4.
You pour his on the floor. Give 4.
Natural 20! You pour his on the floor. Give 8.

cards.title: Leech Swarm
cards.rules: Leeches that drink blood and, apparently, Fireball. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They latch on and won't let go. Drink 6.
They latch on and won't let go. Drink 3.
You salt them. Give 4.
Natural 20! You salt them. Give 8.

cards.title: Hex Witch
cards.rules: A witch who reads tarot and your browser history. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Hexed. Drink 6, and confess your last search.
Hexed. Drink 3, and confess your last search.
You flip her table. Give 4.
Natural 20! You flip her table. Give 8.

cards.title: Vampire Bro
cards.rules: A vampire in a backwards cap who only drinks from frat boys. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He makes an exception. Drink 8.
He makes an exception. Drink 4.
Garlic knots to the face. He drops something. Give 3.
Natural 20! Garlic knots to the face. He drops something. Give 6.

cards.title: Crypt Crawler
cards.rules: Something with a hundred legs and one beer gut. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: It crawls up your shirt. Drink 4, and shake it out.
You stomp it flat. Give 4.

dice.doubles: A pair! You stomp it with both feet. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: Hungover Mummy
cards.rules: A mummy wrapped in bar napkins, hungover for three thousand years. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It throws up sand on you. Drink 8.
It throws up sand on you. Drink 4.
You hand it a Gatorade. It weeps. Give 4.
Natural 20! You hand it a Gatorade. It weeps. Give 8.

cards.title: Karaoke Banshee
cards.rules: A banshee with a mic and a song list. She's picked yours. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Total Eclipse of the Heart. Sing the chorus, then drink 4.
She hits the high note. Your ears bleed. Drink 4.
You unplug the mic. Give 3.
You out-sing her. Give 4.
You duet. It's beautiful. Give 4.
You hit a note so bad she flees. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Lich's Accountant
cards.rules: He's doing the Lich's taxes, and you're a deduction. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Audited. Drink 8.
Audited. Drink 4.
You find an error in his math. Give 4.
Natural 20! You find an error in his math. Give 8.

jinx.name: Question Master
jinx.rule: Anyone who answers a question from the jinxed player drinks 1.

cards.title: Tomb of Silence
cards.rules: No laughing in the tomb. The table gets 30 seconds to crack you. Laugh: drink 4.

cards.title: The Bone Tower
cards.rules: Stack the empties into a tower that stands for 5 seconds. Collapse: drink 4.

cards.title: Backwards Chant
cards.rules: Wake the dead: say the alphabet from Z to A in 20 seconds. Stumble: drink 4.

cards.title: The Seance
cards.rules: Everyone holds hands while you summon a spirit. Make someone laugh in 20 seconds, or drink 4.

cards.title: Collapsing Floor
cards.rules: The floor gives way under you. Roll d20 to grab the edge.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You fall a whole floor. Drink 6.
You fall a whole floor. Drink 3.
You hang on. Give 2.
Natural 20! You hang on. Give 4.

cards.title: Dart Wall
cards.rules: Little holes in both walls. Then a click. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Darted, in the ass. Drink 6 standing.
Darted, in the ass. Drink 3 standing.
You limbo under them. Give 2.
Natural 20! You limbo under them. Give 4.

cards.title: Fog of Regret
cards.rules: A green fog that smells like the tequila from your 21st. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Flashbacks. Drink 6.
Flashbacks. Drink 3.
You hold your breath. Give 2 to whoever was there.
Natural 20! You hold your breath. Give 4 to whoever was there.

jinx.name: Tequila Flashback
jinx.rule: The jinxed player shudders at every drink, like it's tequila. Forget: drink 1.

cards.title: Rolling Skull
cards.rules: A giant stone skull comes down the corridor, Indiana Jones style. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It rolls you flat. Drink 6.
It rolls you flat. Drink 3.
You dive into a side tomb. Give 2, and hum the theme.
Natural 20! You dive into a side tomb. Give 4, and hum the theme.

cards.title: Skeleton Crew
cards.rules: A skeleton bachelorette party wants you to do a shot off a femur. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Off the femur. Drink 6.
Off the femur. Drink 3.
You knock their bones loose. Give 3.
Natural 20! You knock their bones loose. Give 6.

cards.title: The Ghoul Choir
cards.rules: Twelve ghouls in robes singing your name, off key. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You join in. Drink 6.
You join in. Drink 3.
You conduct them into a wall. Give 3.
Natural 20! You conduct them into a wall. Give 6.

cards.title: The Bone Dice
cards.rules: A skeleton rattles a cup of finger bones at you. Win, then cash out or go again. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Snake eyes. Drink 8.
Snake eyes. Drink 4.
He clacks his jaw. Give 3.
Natural 20! He clacks his jaw. Give 6.

cards.title: Cursed Idol
cards.rules: A gold idol on a plinth. Nothing bad could possibly happen. Grab it, or leave it.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The plinth bleeds. So do you. Drink 6.
The plinth bleeds. So do you. Drink 3.
Real gold, and something rattling inside. Give 4.
Natural 20! Real gold, and something rattling inside. Give 8.

cards.title: Bone Vending Machine
cards.rules: A vending machine full of teeth and, at the back, one draught. Shake it, or leave it.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It tips onto you. Drink 8.
It tips onto you. Drink 4.
Clunk. Give 3.
Natural 20! Clunk. Give 6.

cards.title: The Sarcophagus
cards.rules: A stone coffin with OPEN ME scratched on the lid, from the inside. Open it, or don't.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Something hugs you. Drink 8.
Something hugs you. Drink 4.
Just a very nice shield. Give 4.
Natural 20! Just a very nice shield. Give 8.

cards.title: The Bone Pile
cards.rules: Under the bones: a smoke bomb and a stranger's fake ID. Keep both. Drink 1.

cards.title: The Offering Bowl
cards.rules: A bowl of coins left for the dead, and a draught nobody touched. Take it. Drink 1.

cards.title: Candlelit Alcove
cards.rules: Someone left candles and a case of water down here. Everyone drinks water. Yes, really.

cards.title: The Ossuary Bar
cards.rules: A bar made of bones, closed for centuries, with one last round. Everyone toasts the dead.

cards.title: The Grave Robber
cards.rules: A grave robber with a cart of stolen goods and no questions asked. Prices are firm.

cards.title: The Undertaker
cards.rules: He measures you for a coffin while he sells you things. He's very thorough.

cards.title: The Split
cards.rules: The tunnel splits. Left: silence. Right: drums, chanting, and what might be a conga line.

cards.title: Two Crypts
cards.rules: Two crypt doors. One says REST. The other says PARTY, in fresh blood.

elite.title: The Crypt Keeper's Mom
elite.rules: She's been waiting up. Do you know what time it is? Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Grounded, in a tomb. Drink 10, then text your mom.
Grounded, in a tomb. Drink 5, then text your mom.
You hug her. She packs you something for the road. Give 5.
Natural 20! You hug her. She packs you something for the road. Give 10.

spoils.name: Mom's Packed Lunch
spoils.rules: Every heal heals 1 more. Comes with a Healing Draught.

elite.title: Death's Intern
elite.rules: Death's unpaid intern is behind on quota, and you'll do. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Filed. Drink 10.
Filed. Drink 5.
You fill out his forms wrong. He runs, and drops his badge. Give 5.
Natural 20! You fill out his forms wrong. He runs, and drops his badge. Give 10.

elite.title: The Bone Dragon
elite.rules: A dragon skeleton with a tiny hat, guarding a pile of bottle caps. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It sits on you. Drink 10.
It sits on you. Drink 5.
You take the hat. It deflates. Give 5.
Natural 20! You take the hat. It deflates. Give 10.

cards.title: Hangover Hydra
cards.rules: Every head you cut off grows back with a headache. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It breathes regret. Drink 10.
It breathes regret. Drink 5.
A head comes off. Give 4.
Natural 20! Clean through the neck. Everyone else drinks 3.

cards.title: The Bouncer
cards.rules: Seven feet of door guy in a tight black tee. Nobody gets past him. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He throws you out. Finish your drink.
He throws you down the stairs. Drink 5.
You get past one arm. Give 4.
Natural 20! You get past one arm. Give 8.

jinx.name: No First Names
jinx.rule: Nobody says a first name. Slip: drink 1.

spoils.name: Bouncer's Flashlight
spoils.rules: +1 to monster, trap and relic rolls.

cards.title: DJ Ossuary
cards.rules: A skeleton DJ who only plays the Macarena. Everyone does the Macarena, then you roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He drops the bass on you. Drink 10.
He drops the bass on you. Drink 5.
You yank a cable. Give 4.
Natural 20! You steal the aux. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: The Aux Cord
spoils.rules: Natural 20 on a 19 or 20. Every heal heals 1 more.

cards.title: The Lich Lord
cards.rules: He keeps his soul in a shot glass and he's daring you to drink it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You drink his soul. Finish your drink.
His soul is Jägermeister. Drink 5.
You smash the shot glass. Give 4.
Natural 20! You smash the shot glass. Give 8.

spoils.name: Phylactery Shot
spoils.rules: −1 max heart. Comes with a Second Wind.

spoils.name: Lich's Crown
spoils.rules: +1 to boss rolls. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20.

cards.title: Ghost of Closings Past
cards.rules: Every bar that ever closed on you, back, and they all want one more. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They kick you out of every one. Drink 10.
They kick you out of every one. Drink 5.
You pay the last tab. They rest. Give 4.
Natural 20! You buy the whole bar. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: Lost Tab
spoils.rules: Comes with a Loaded Die and a Coaster Shield.

cards.title: The Boiler Room
cards.rules: Warm pipes and a cot someone lives on. Everyone warms their hands. Level up, or lie down.

cards.title: A Campfire
cards.rules: Someone lit a fire in a keg. Everyone tells the scariest thing that's happened tonight.

cards.title: The Staff Room
cards.rules: A kettle and a sign: WASH YOUR OWN MUG. Everyone mimes it. Level up, or put the kettle on.

cards.title: The Fire Escape
cards.rules: Stars, a city, and the street far below. Everyone toasts how far you've come.

cards.title: Deep Fryer Demon
cards.rules: It'll fry anything. It's looking at your hand. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Battered. Drink 10.
Battered. Drink 5.
You throw ice in it. Give 5.
Natural 20! You throw ice in it. Give 10.

cards.title: Line Cook Golem
cards.rules: Seven feet of burns and tattoos, ten tickets deep, and you're in the way. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Behind! Drink 10.
Behind! Drink 5.
You run his food. He respects you. Give 5.
Natural 20! You run his food. He respects you. Give 10.

jinx.name: Behind!
jinx.rule: The jinxed player yells 'Behind!' whenever they stand up. Forget: drink 1.

cards.title: Sentient Sourdough
cards.rules: The starter has been fed for forty years. It wants more. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It rises over you. Drink 10.
It rises over you. Drink 5.
You punch it down. Give 5 to whoever owns a sourdough starter.
Natural 20! You punch it down. Give 10 to whoever owns a sourdough starter.

cards.title: Garlic Breath Wraith
cards.rules: A wraith that only ever exhales. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It breathes on you. Drink 8.
It breathes on you. Drink 4.
You hold your breath. Give 5.
Natural 20! You hold your breath. Give 10.

cards.title: The Expo
cards.rules: The expo is screaming for hands, and you have hands. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Plates everywhere. Drink 5.
You drop table six's steak. Drink 5.
You burn your palm on a plate. Drink 5.
Order up. Give 4.
Order up, hot and fast. Give 5.
You run six plates at once. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: Food Critic Ghoul
cards.rules: A ghoul with a notebook. One star, and he hasn't eaten yet. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! One star. Drink 10, and give the room a one-star review out loud.
One star. Drink 5, and give the room a one-star review out loud.
You comp his meal. He leaves a draught as a tip. Give 4.
Natural 20! You comp his meal. He leaves a draught as a tip. Give 8.

cards.title: Walk-In Yeti
cards.rules: Something lives in the walk-in, and it ate the shrimp. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It locks you in. Finish your drink.
Cold hug. Drink 5.
You lock it in. Give 5.
Natural 20! You lock it in. Give 10.

cards.title: Dish Pit Horror
cards.rules: Something under the dish pit water has been eating forks. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: It eats your fork. Drink 5.
You pull the plug. Give 5.

dice.doubles: A pair! You pull the plug and it goes with it. Everyone else drinks 3.

cards.title: The Screaming Chef
cards.rules: A ghost chef who calls everything raw. It's not even food. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're an idiot sandwich. Drink 10.
You're an idiot sandwich. Drink 5.
You serve him something perfect. He goes quiet. Give 5.
Natural 20! You serve him something perfect. He goes quiet. Give 10.

jinx.name: Idiot Sandwich
jinx.rule: The jinxed player answers to 'idiot sandwich' only. Answer to their name: drink 1.

cards.title: Rogue Rotisserie
cards.rules: Twelve chickens on a spit, turning, and turning toward you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Basted. Drink 10.
Basted. Drink 5.
You carve your way out. Give 5.
Natural 20! You carve your way out. Give 10.

cards.title: Yes, Chef
cards.rules: For 30 seconds, answer everything anyone says with 'Yes, chef!' Miss one: drink 5.

cards.title: Four Plates
cards.rules: Carry four empties on one arm across the room and back. Drop one: drink 5.

cards.title: The Hot Sauce Wall
cards.rules: Name ten hot sauces, real or made up, in 20 seconds. Stumble: drink 5.

cards.title: The Pitch
cards.rules: Pitch the table a new dish in 20 seconds. Everyone votes; fewer than half love it: drink 5.

cards.title: Grease Fire
cards.rules: Somebody threw water on it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Singed. Drink 8.
Singed. Drink 4.
You smother it with a lid. Give 3.
Natural 20! You smother it with a lid. Give 6.

cards.title: Wet Floor
cards.rules: There was a sign. You ignored it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Down. Drink 8, and lie on the floor for 5 seconds.
Down. Drink 4, and lie on the floor for 5 seconds.
You skate it. Give 3.
Natural 20! You skate it. Give 6.

cards.title: The Swinging Door
cards.rules: One door, in and out, and a server is coming through with a full tray. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Tray to the face. Drink 8.
Tray to the face. Drink 4.
You spin past. Give 3.
Natural 20! You spin past. Give 6.

cards.title: The Mandoline
cards.rules: The guard is off the mandoline and it's slicing on its own. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Thinly sliced. Drink 8.
Thinly sliced. Drink 4.
You slide the guard back on. Give 3.
Natural 20! You slide the guard back on. Give 6.

cards.title: Raccoon Crew
cards.rules: Two raccoons in chef's hats are stealing the bread. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They take your fries too. Drink 8.
They take your fries too. Drink 4.
You chase them out. Give 4.
Natural 20! You chase them out. Give 8.

cards.title: The Brunch Crowd
cards.rules: It's 2 a.m. and a brunch crowd has arrived demanding bottomless mimosas. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Bottomless. Drink 8.
Bottomless. Drink 4.
You tell them it's dinner. Their minds break. Give 4.
Natural 20! You tell them it's dinner. Their minds break. Give 8.

cards.title: Hot Sauce Ladder
cards.rules: Each rung is a hotter sauce. Win, then cash out or climb again, harder. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Your mouth is on fire. Drink 10.
Your mouth is on fire. Drink 5.
You don't blink once. Give 4.
Natural 20! You don't blink once. Give 8.

cards.title: The Back Burner
cards.rules: A pot that's been simmering since the flood. Taste it, or leave it.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Fish heads. Drink 10.
Fish heads. Drink 5.
Best soup of your life, and a draught for later. Give 5.
Natural 20! Best soup of your life, and a draught for later. Give 10.

cards.title: The Mystery Meat
cards.rules: A covered tray marked DO NOT SERVE. It's warm. Lift the lid, or don't.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It lifts the lid back. Drink 10.
It lifts the lid back. Drink 5.
Brisket. Perfect brisket. Give 5.
Natural 20! Brisket. Perfect brisket. Give 10.

cards.title: Staff Meal
cards.rules: Fries, pickles, and a shot the cooks hid for you. Drink 1, and pocket a smoke bomb.

cards.title: Knife Roll
cards.rules: A chef's knife roll left on the pass, something heavy in the end pocket. Drink 1.

cards.title: The Break Room
cards.rules: A couch, a microwave, and twelve minutes of peace. Everyone sits down and sips.

cards.title: Family Meal
cards.rules: The cooks sit down to eat, and they set a place for you. Everyone toasts the cooks.

cards.title: The Dishwasher
cards.rules: The dishwasher has seen everything, and he'll sell you some of it, for drinks or blood.

cards.title: The Sous Chef
cards.rules: The sous chef is selling the head chef's stash, quietly, out the back.

cards.title: The Pass
cards.rules: Two ways out: the quiet back door, or straight through the line in the dinner rush.

cards.title: The Dumbwaiter
cards.rules: The fire stairs, or the dumbwaiter, which is shaking and going down on its own.

elite.title: The Head Chef
elite.rules: He's thrown a pan at everyone tonight. You're next. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The pan. Drink 12.
The pan. Drink 6.
You say 'Heard, chef.' He's moved, and hands you his lucky knife. Give 6.
Natural 20! You say 'Heard, chef.' He's moved, and hands you his lucky knife. Give 12.

elite.title: The Butcher
elite.rules: The butcher is sharpening, and sharpening, and sharpening. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Filleted. Drink 12.
Filleted. Drink 6.
You take his apron. It's basically armor. Give 6.
Natural 20! You take his apron. It's basically armor. Give 12.

elite.title: The Owner
elite.rules: He's back from his third divorce and he's doing the books tonight. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He blames you for the books. Drink 12.
He blames you for the books. Drink 6.
You find the money. He makes you a partner. Give 6.
Natural 20! You find the money. He makes you a partner. Give 12.

spoils.name: Partner's Keyring
spoils.rules: +1 satchel slot. Comes with 2 Healing Draughts.

spoils.name: Owner's Comp Card
spoils.rules: +1 to ambush rolls. Every heal heals 1 more.

cards.title: The Last Table
cards.rules: The Quarter-Zips want your table. Brad is already sitting on it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Brad sits on you. Drink 8.
Brad sits on you. Drink 4.
You tip the table, gently. Give 4.
Natural 20! You tip Brad off it. Everyone else drinks 3.

cards.title: A Toast to the Boys
cards.rules: Thad is giving a toast about 'the boys', eleven minutes in. Roll d20 to cut him off.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You cry at it. Finish your drink.
It's moving, somehow. Raise a glass and drink 4.
You raise a glass mid-sentence and everyone drinks. Give 4.
Natural 20! You raise a glass mid-sentence and everyone drinks. Give 8.

cards.title: Chad's Last Round
cards.rules: Chad ordered the last round, for the boys only. Intercept it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He drinks yours in front of you. Drink 8.
He drinks yours in front of you. Drink 4.
You carry the tray to your own table. Give 4.
Natural 20! You carry the tray, and Chad tips you. Everyone else drinks 3.

jinx.name: For the Boys
jinx.rule: The jinxed player says 'for the boys' before every drink. Forget: drink 1.

cards.title: Brad's Venmo Request
cards.rules: Brad has Venmo-requested everyone here $14.50 for 'vibes'. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You accidentally pay it. Drink 8.
You accidentally pay it. Drink 4.
You request $15 back for 'better vibes'. Give 4.
Natural 20! You request $15 back for 'better vibes'. Give 8.

cards.title: The Dance-Off
cards.rules: The Quarter-Zips call a dance-off. The whole bar is watching. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Brad does the worm. You can't follow that. Drink 4.
You pull something. Drink 4.
Thad dips you. You let him. Drink 4.
You do the robot, and mean it. Give 4.
You moonwalk out the door and back. Give 4.
Everyone in the bar joins your dance. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Last Call Lich
cards.rules: Lights up. Music off. It's last call forever unless you kill it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Closing time. Everyone drinks 8.
Closing time. Everyone drinks 4.
It flickers. Give 5.
Natural 20! The music comes back on. Everyone else drinks 4.

cards.title: The Bartender Below
cards.rules: It knows your usual. It knows what you did. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It cuts you off. Drink 12.
It cuts you off. Drink 6.
You tip it. It staggers. Give 5.
Natural 20! You rob the tip jar. Everyone else drinks 4.

cards.title: The Final Tab
cards.rules: Every drink you've ever ordered, itemized, four feet long, and it has teeth. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Itemized. Drink 10.
Itemized. Drink 5.
You dispute a charge. Give 5.
Natural 20! Comped. Everyone else drinks 4.

cards.title: The House Lights
cards.rules: The lights come up, and everyone looks like that. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You saw yourself. Drink 12.
You saw yourself. Drink 6.
You smash a bulb. Give 5.
Natural 20! Darkness again. Everyone else drinks 4.

cards.title: The 2 a.m. Kebab
cards.rules: It's been turning since 8 p.m. It knew you'd come. It's the size of a door. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You drop it on the floor and eat it anyway. Drink 8.
Garlic sauce, everywhere. Drink 5.
You carve it down to the spit. Give 5.
Natural 20! You eat the whole thing, standing. Everyone else drinks 4.

cards.title: Surge Pricing
cards.rules: The ride home costs $94 and it's sentient. It's circling the block, laughing. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Surge goes up again. Drink 10.
Surge goes up again. Drink 5.
You find a driver who's going your way. Give 5.
Natural 20! Free ride. Everyone else drinks 4.

cards.title: The Group Chat
cards.rules: Tomorrow's group chat, awake early, reading tonight back to you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Someone posts the video. Drink 12.
Someone posts the video. Drink 6.
You leave the chat. It can't follow. Give 5.
Natural 20! You mute it forever. Everyone else drinks 4.

jinx.name: Muted
jinx.rule: The jinxed player can only mime. Say a word: drink 1.

cards.title: The Morning After
cards.rules: Your hangover from tomorrow came back in time to stop you. It's enormous. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It lands a preview. Drink 10 and a glass of water.
It lands a preview. Drink 5 and a glass of water.
You promise it a greasy breakfast. It backs off. Give 5.
Natural 20! You were never going to have a hangover. Everyone else drinks 4.
